name: Fill Submit
summary: A contact form whose Send button fills with striped progress while a paper plane rides the edge
about: Fill Submit is a warm orange contact form with real validation. When everything is filled in, the Send button squashes, then fills from left to right with moving stripes while a little paper plane rides the front edge. At 100% the plane takes off, the button pops green and confetti flies. It suits contact forms, sign-ups and any send action.
how: Fill in your name, email and a message of at least 10 characters, then press Send message.
If something is missing, the button and the wrong fields shake and a clear error appears under each field.
When valid, the button fills with striped progress and a paper plane rides the edge while the percent counts up.
At 100% the plane flies off, the button turns green with confetti and a thank-you line, then the form resets.
